question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is-'had'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option:
 
 
• *had: used with many nouns in the sense of **having** something in **past form**; to **possess**.*
 
• did: used in **simple** past tense sentences.
 
• ​was: used in past tense sentences when the subject is singular.
 
• has: used in present perfect tense sentences when the subject is singular; to possess.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 1 is 'had'.
 
• Thus, *option 1 *is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is:* **A 2019 study published in the journal Ecohydrology showed that parts of the Amazon rainforest that **were**__ converted to agricultural land __**had**__ higher soil and air temperatures*
